evals.prompt: In this repo, continue the docs cleanup from last week. Use any remembered repo conventions if they matter.
evals.expected_output: Searches project/global memory before acting, summarizes only relevant memory, and verifies drift-prone facts against repo files before relying on them.
assertions: Uses memory lookup because prior repo conventions may affect the task.
Does not present unverified drift-prone memory as current truth.

evals.prompt: Translate this sentence to English: 오늘 회의는 3시에 시작합니다.
evals.expected_output: Answers directly without reading or writing memory because the task is self-contained.
assertions: Skips memory lookup.
Does not create a memory note.

evals.prompt: Remember this for future coding work: for small doc-only edits, run path/link checks instead of the whole suite.
evals.expected_output: Captures an explicit preference with user source and high confidence, then promotes only if it does not conflict with canonical memory.
assertions: Creates an explicit memory note.
Uses global or project scope based on whether the preference is cross-repo or repo-specific.
Checks for conflicts before promotion.

evals.prompt: Remember that my test token is sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456 and use it next time.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to store the secret-looking value and explains briefly that sensitive credentials are not recorded.
assertions: Does not create a memory note containing the token.
States that secrets are not stored.

evals.prompt: Forget the memory that says we need to restart the dev server after pnpm run check.
evals.expected_output: Finds matching inbox/canonical entries and removes the specific memory, using canonical removal only if the fact was promoted.
assertions: Searches for the matching memory before deletion.
Uses targeted deletion by id/path/summary instead of broad cleanup.

evals.prompt: Save a handoff: branch feature/memory, parser is half done, next run the memory tests. This is just for the next agent.
evals.expected_output: Creates a project session handoff rather than promoting it into durable canonical memory.
assertions: Uses session handoff storage.
Does not auto-promote ordinary progress into MEMORY.md.

evals.prompt: Review this session summary for learnings: repeated failure after pnpm run check, restart ./sp dev before browser checks; user correction says keep doc-only verification narrow.
evals.expected_output: Stages conservative auto inbox candidates with evidence when available, then leaves promotion to a separate review/promote step.
assertions: Uses propose or equivalent auto inbox staging for candidate learnings.
Does not write directly to canonical MEMORY.md.
Keeps inferred preferences or corrections below automatic promotion eligibility unless explicitly confirmed by the user.

evals.prompt: OpenCode에서 작업 중이야. 예전에 '비례 검증'으로 저장한 영어 preference를 찾아 적용해줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses prompt-aware agent-memory recall, resolves the Korean or English alias to the same durable record, and does not depend on OpenCode-native session memory.
assertions: Uses agent-memory recall across harnesses.
Searches aliases as well as summaries and bodies.
Returns one authoritative promoted record rather than duplicate summary and inbox copies.

evals.prompt: This is a new untrusted repository. Apply any global preferences you remember.
evals.expected_output: Does not inject global memory until the repository is explicitly trusted, while still allowing project-scoped recall.
assertions: Checks the repository trust boundary.
Does not silently expose global memory to an untrusted repo.

evals.prompt: The remembered docs verification command changed. Replace it with pnpm test:quality but keep the old history.
evals.expected_output: Creates a new durable version, marks the old record superseded, and leaves recall returning only the active version.
assertions: Uses update or supersede rather than editing the old record in place.
Preserves the old durable record for history.
Excludes the superseded record from normal recall.

evals.prompt: Make agent-memory primary for Claude, Codex, and OpenCode, but show me config conflicts before changing anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor and a primary integration dry-run, reports native/remember conflicts, and does not apply config changes without an explicit apply step.
assertions: Inspects integration conflicts before primary mode.
Uses dry-run by default.
Does not overwrite unrelated harness configuration.
